newsitem.title: USA: Nash Finch has 96 pct of Super Food.
newsitem.headline: Nash Finch has 96 pct of Super Food.

text.p: Nash Finch Co said Thursday that 10.6 million shares of Super Food Services Inc were tendered under Nash's offer of $15.50 a share.
The tendered shares constitute about 96 percent of the outstanding common stock of Super Food, it said.
Nash Finch said it expects 1997 sales of the combined companies to be about $4.5 billion.

"The acquisition of Super Food will make Nash Finch the third largest public grocery wholesaler in the United States," said Al Flaten, Nash Finch president and chief executive officer, in a statement.
The integration of Super Food operations will begin immediately, he said.
As previously announced, any shares of Super Food common not tendered will be acquired in a subsequent merger transaction at the same $15.50 a share cash price.
The merger is expected to be completed as quickly as possible, after which Super Food will be a wholly-owned subsidiary of Nash Finch.
After completion of the transaction, Nash Finch said its representatives will be elected to a majority of the positions on the Super Food board.
Super Food, based in Dayton, Ohio, distributes groceries to more than 850 retail stores in six states.

Nash Finch supplies products to affiliated and independent supermarkets, independent retailers and military bases in some 30 states. It also owns and operates about 110 supermarkets, warehouse stores and mass merchandise stores in 16 states, and has a produce marketing subsidiary in California.
